_comment: Generated by fetch/normals.py; do not edit by hand. Monthly UV normals per city: months[0] is January, null where fewer than 60 valid days. median is the median daily peak; protect, veryHigh and extreme are the share of days at 3+, 8+ and 11+ after half-up rounding. arpansa = measured (CC BY 2.5 AU, data.gov.au); noaa = NOAA CPC noon forecasts (public domain).
